title: Exploration of the therapeutic potential of magnoflorine against osteoarthritis progression using network pharmacology and in vitro validation.
authors: Wang, Chengbin; Cui, Lu; Tantai, Mengxiao; Feng, Gangning; Cai, Zhe; Feng, Yu
one_liner_zh: 该文通过网络药理学和体外实验研究木兰花碱对骨关节炎的作用机制，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: Osteoarthritis (OA) is a chronic joint disease characterized by cartilage degeneration, synovial inflammation and imbalanced subchondral bone remodeling, in which chronic inflammation plays a critical role. This study aimed to investigate the potential molecular mechanism of magnoflorine against OA and verify it via in vitro experiments. Potential targets of magnoflorine were predicted using TCMSP, SwissTargetPrediction and OA-related databases, followed by intersection gene and functional enrichment analyses via STRING and Cytoscape. Molecular docking revealed strong binding affinity of magnoflorine with IL-1beta, TNF-alpha and MMP-9. KEGG analysis indicated that magnoflorine mainly modulated TNF, MAPK and NF-kappaB signaling pathways. In IL-1beta-stimulated MC3T3-E1, RAW264.7 and mouse primary chondrocytes, magnoflorine (25-100 mug/mL) showed no obvious cytotoxicity and restored cell viability. It promoted osteogenic migration and mineralization, upregulated osteogenic markers, and inhibited RANKL-induced osteoclastogenesis. Mechanistically, magnoflorine suppressed abnormal activation of the p38 MAPK/NF-kappaB pathway and promoted SRC/STAT3 phosphorylation, thus downregulating pro-inflammatory and matrix-degrading factors while upregulating IL-10. In chondrocytes, it upregulated Col2a1 and downregulated MMP3/MMP13. In summary, magnoflorine mitigates OA progression by enhancing osteoblast function, inhibiting osteoclastogenesis, maintaining cartilage homeostasis and attenuating inflammation via blocking the NF-kappaB/MAPK pathway, suggesting its potential as a candidate agent for OA treatment.
abstract_zh: 骨关节炎（OA）是一种以软骨退变、滑膜炎症和软骨下骨重塑失衡为特征的慢性关节疾病，其中慢性炎症起关键作用。本研究旨在探讨木兰花碱（magnoflorine）对抗OA的潜在分子机制，并通过体外实验加以验证。利用TCMSP、SwissTargetPrediction及OA相关数据库预测木兰花碱的潜在靶点，随后通过STRING和Cytoscape进行交集基因及功能富集分析。分子对接显示木兰花碱与IL-1β、TNF-α和MMP-9具有强结合亲和力。KEGG分析表明，木兰花碱主要调节TNF、MAPK和NF-κB信号通路。在IL-1β刺激的MC3T3-E1、RAW264.7和小鼠原代软骨细胞中，木兰花碱（25-100 μg/mL）未显示明显细胞毒性，并恢复细胞活力。它促进成骨细胞迁移和矿化，上调成骨标志物，并抑制RANKL诱导的破骨细胞生成。机制上，木兰花碱抑制p38 MAPK/NF-κB通路的异常激活，并促进SRC/STAT3磷酸化，从而下调促炎和基质降解因子，同时上调IL-10。在软骨细胞中，它上调Col2a1并下调MMP3/MMP13。总之，木兰花碱通过阻断NF-κB/MAPK通路，增强成骨细胞功能、抑制破骨细胞生成、维持软骨稳态并减轻炎症，从而缓解OA进展，提示其作为OA治疗候选药物的潜力。
